1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Inspect one read-only reference buffer, repair its two fields, and leave one pager layer.
1.natural_language: Inspect the read-only reference buffer, repair both manifest fields in Vim, write and quit, then leave the remaining terminal layer.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Reconcile four fields from two references, then leave two distinct terminal modes.
2.natural_language: Inspect both read-only buffers, repair all four manifest fields in Vim, write and quit, then unwind the terminal layers.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Reconcile six fields spread across three reference buffers before leaving two modal terminal layers.
3.natural_language: Inspect all three read-only buffers, repair all six manifest fields in Vim, write and quit, then unwind the terminal layers.

4.label: hard
4.summary: The original configuration: six distributed fields, three required reference buffers, and the complete four-mode terminal stack.
4.natural_language: Inspect all three read-only buffers, repair all six manifest fields in Vim, write and quit, then unwind every outer terminal layer.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Reconcile eight fields across four references while retaining the complete four-mode terminal escape sequence.
5.natural_language: Inspect all four read-only buffers, repair all eight manifest fields in Vim, write and quit, then unwind every outer terminal layer.

simplified.summary: Use visible buffer, line-edit, save, and active-layer proxy controls; field values still must be read and entered from the rendered references.

full.summary: Use direct Vim and terminal keyboard input, including buffer commands, modal edits, command mode, control chords, and typed shell exit.
